note: The actor IRI contract as DATA, not prose. Three rounds running, a defect was closed in Python and in Python-side vectors while the normative document still described the superseded rule -- and the document is what a second implementation reads. These cases are the rule: an implementation that reproduces every `iri` from its `actor` agrees with SEV on actor identity, without reading any Python. Inputs are base64 of the UTF-8 actor id, because a JSON string cannot carry a lone surrogate or an unpaired byte and the boundary cases are exactly where implementations diverge.
rule: urn:wrt:actor: || pct(actor). pct retains the ASCII unreserved set A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~ literally and encodes every other UTF-8 octet as %HH with UPPERCASE hex digits.
minted_only_when: A signature reported valid:true AND binding:"bound". Before that the actor is a claim the record makes, not an identity the bundle can name, and the weak default `wrt:claimedActor` is a literal.

cases.name: JavaScript's extra safe set is NOT retained
the delimiters an actor id actually carries are encoded
hex is uppercase, which RFC 3986 leaves optional
encoding is over UTF-8 octets, not code points
an actor id that is already percent-looking is re-encoded

helper_totality.note: NOT part of the actor-identity contract. The body schema requires a non-empty actor.id and signature derivation rejects an empty actor, so an empty actor id is unreachable in a conformant receipt. The encoder is nonetheless total over it; that is an implementation property, and canonising it beside the product cases would teach a second implementation to mint identity for a state the protocol does not admit.

cases.name: an empty actor id encodes to an empty suffix

rule_is_prose: `rule` and `note` are PROSE. The harness does not execute them and cannot: editing this text to say the opposite leaves every case green, which is the same rot that made the profile disagree with the code for four consecutive rounds. The CONTRACT is `cases` — each one carries the exact bytes and the exact expected outcome, and the harness replays them. Read the prose to understand the intent; trust only the cases.
